name: travel-guide
description: Create a practical travel guide and review it for feasibility, safety, pacing, and missing assumptions.

stages.name: plan-brief
prompt: Create a concise travel planning brief from stage-input.trip and stage-input.intent.
Focus on traveler profile, constraints, route assumptions, pacing, and must-cover planning risks.
Do not claim live opening hours, ticket prices, or real-time availability.

stages.name: draft-itinerary
prompt: Read input.planningBriefFile, then write a practical travel guide for input.trip and input.intent.
Include a day-by-day itinerary, transport notes, meal style suggestions, backup options, packing reminders, and budget bands.
Keep recommendations useful but avoid presenting time-sensitive details as verified facts.

stages.name: review-itinerary
prompt: Review input.travelGuideFile for feasibility, safety, pacing, and missing assumptions.
Return a short Markdown review with pass/fail recommendation and concrete improvements.
